title: Tip from Angela - Dealing with Distractions
summary: A short productivity tip: remove distractions while studying, because even brief interruptions cost a lot of focus time.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Brief interruptions, even a minute long, can take far longer to recover from; the lecture cites research suggesting up to roughly 25 minutes to regain prior focus.
Practical habit: before a study session, put the phone in airplane mode and out of sight, such as in a drawer.
Distractions differ per person: they may be people nearby, in which case close a door, or the time of day, in which case study early morning or late evening.
Experiment with removing them and observe whether focus and output improve.

pitfalls: Keeping the phone within reach with notifications on during coding sessions.
